auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Dandelion API token. Create and manage it at https://dandelion.eu/profile/plans-and-pricing/.

actions.name: analyze_sentiment
actions.description: Analyze the sentiment expressed by plain text with Dandelion.

language.description: The ISO 639-1 language code. Omit it to let Dandelion detect the language.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for analyzing sentiment with Dandelion.

timestamp.description: The response generation timestamp returned by Dandelion.

time.description: The processing time in milliseconds returned by Dandelion.

lang.description: The ISO 639-1 language code used for the analysis.

langConfidence.description: The language detection confidence from 0 to 1 when Dandelion detects it.

outputSchema.description: The sentiment analysis result returned by Dandelion.

actions.name: compare_text_similarity
actions.description: Compare the semantic similarity of two plain texts with Dandelion.

firstText.description: The first plain text to compare.

secondText.description: The second plain text to compare.

language.description: The ISO 639-1 language code. Omit it to let Dandelion detect the language.

bagOfWords.description: Whether to compare the texts as bags of words instead of preserving word order.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for comparing text similarity with Dandelion.

timestamp.description: The response generation timestamp returned by Dandelion.

time.description: The processing time in milliseconds returned by Dandelion.

lang.description: The ISO 639-1 language code used for the analysis.

langConfidence.description: The language detection confidence from 0 to 1 when Dandelion detects it.

similarity.description: The semantic similarity score from 0 to 1.

outputSchema.description: The text similarity result returned by Dandelion.

actions.name: detect_language
actions.description: Detect the languages present in plain text with Dandelion.

clean.description: Whether Dandelion should remove URLs, email addresses, hashtags, and mentions before detection.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for detecting languages with Dandelion.

timestamp.description: The response generation timestamp returned by Dandelion.

time.description: The processing time in milliseconds returned by Dandelion.

detectedLanguages.description: The detected languages ordered by confidence.

outputSchema.description: The language detection result returned by Dandelion.

actions.name: extract_entities
actions.description: Extract linked entities and their positions from plain text with Dandelion.

language.description: The ISO 639-1 language code. Omit it to let Dandelion detect the language.

minimumConfidence.description: The minimum entity confidence from 0 to 1.

maximumEntities.description: The maximum number of top entities to include in addition to annotations.

items.description: One detail group: types, abstract, categories, image, lod, or alternate_labels.

include.description: The optional entity detail groups to include.

country.description: The two-letter country code used to improve entity disambiguation.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for extracting entities with Dandelion.

timestamp.description: The response generation timestamp returned by Dandelion.

time.description: The processing time in milliseconds returned by Dandelion.

lang.description: The ISO 639-1 language code used for the analysis.

langConfidence.description: The language detection confidence from 0 to 1 when Dandelion detects it.

label.description: The entity label returned by Dandelion.

start.description: The zero-based start offset of the matching span.

end.description: The exclusive end offset of the matching span.

items.description: One entity annotation returned by Dandelion.

annotations.description: The entities found in the text.

score.description: The entity importance score within this text.

items.description: One top-ranked entity returned by Dandelion.

topEntities.description: The highest-ranked entities when maximumEntities was requested.

outputSchema.description: The entity extraction result returned by Dandelion.
